main_text.l: praedicantes ministriqueomnes, nempe ut Paulus fuit ἀφωρισμένῳ

page.notes: The marginal numbers 61 and 62 are printed line numbers in the left margin; 62 stands beside the line "Et isto modo multi adhuc essent Pharisæi". Greek words are read with doubt, especially "ἀφωρισμένῳ" (possibly ἀφωρισμένῳ/ἀφωρισμένος) and "εἰς" forms; the Greek is blurred in the scan and should be checked. The line "Quamvis ego imperitus" is set in italic. A small Greek-looking mark at the left margin near "erat" was not transcribed. The Greek on the "ἀφωρισμένῳ" lines is uncertain and may contain [?] readings in print.
